title: World War One
note: Dimensional rigour is the strength; the Argument chapter performs the essay by narrating its own structure, and the per-power chapters repeat one dimension order.

title: Starmer endgame / Arsenal title
note: Strong leads and clear prose, but this is the run that leaked special-edition .sp-* components into a weekly and routed front-matter around the gates.

title: Eating at Efteling & Beekse Bergen
note: Vivid and concrete throughout; occasional adjective-led food writing edges toward performance but never loses the information.

title: The First Roman Emperors
note: A genuinely strong issue with a tight thesis and high fact density; the only real drag is that the four middle reign-chapters (Tiberius/Caligula/Claudius/Nero) march through a similar succession-mechanics-then-what-it-proved mold with a hostile-sources NOTE each, flattening the rhythm the bookend chapters otherwise vary well.

title: The week everyone spent waiting
note: Density and hooks are excellent, but several sections close on the same concrete-claim-then-deflating-pull-quote move, giving the twelve-section read a faintly repetitive rhythm.

title: The Next — After Dragon Ball & Star Wars
note: The named three-criteria thesis is carried and pressure-tested through every pick, but the three tiered recommendation chapters repeat an identical pick-card-plus-on-ramp template that flattens after the second pass.

title: A truce that lasted a day
note: Genuine component variety carries the read, but the compare-panel and also-list patterns recur across Toolkit, Shelf and Places, keeping structure just short of distinct-shape-per-section.

title: Efteling & Beekse Bergen
note: Plain, confident prose; recurring X-not-Y parallel construction opens both halves identically and a few aphorisms lean toward cadence.

title: Burnham walks back into the Commons
note: Density and the realignment angle carry the issue; voice is the softest dimension, recurring to posed binaries and withheld-payoff lines reached for rhythm rather than information.
